summary: United Maritime Corp, a Greek-incorporated foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its letter to shareholders and proxy materials for the 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders set for November 4, 2026, in Glyfada, Greece. Shareholders will vote on re-electing Christina Anagnostara and Ioannis Kartsonas as Class A Directors and ratifying Ernst & Young (Hellas) as auditors for fiscal 2026. The letter cites 15 consecutive quarterly dividends totaling $2.04 per share, vessel sales and two Capesize additions, and a $15.1 million offshore newbuilding exit; these are routine disclosure items, not a standalone special situation.
